ChunkLevel.finding: Entity-ticking threshold is 31; block-ticking threshold is 32; full threshold is 33.

ChunkMap.finding: Server view setting clamps to 2..32. Player request clamps to 2..server view. Forced ticket level is ChunkLevel.byStatus(ENTITY_TICKING), level 31.

ChunkTrackingView.finding: Contains passes includeOuter=true; inner predicate passes false. Exact rounded integer predicate is reproduced by calculate_requirements.py.

ChunkTrackingView-Positioned.finding: forEach tests the default two-argument contains for each possible chunk; explicit contains delegates to the same static rounded predicate.

DistanceManager.finding: Forced ticket added to both normal and ticking trackers. Player ticket level is max(0,31-simulationDistance), so increasing the setting beyond 31 cannot continue lowering it.

ForceLoadCommand.finding: The one requested inclusive chunk rectangle is compared against 256. On acceptance, each coordinate is passed to setChunkForced; no total forced-set size check occurs in this method.

Options.finding: Render-distance option range is 2..32 for the 64-bit / at-least-1,000,000,000-max-heap path, otherwise 2..16. Simulation-distance option is 5..32 or 5..16. Effective render distance is limited by server distance when positive.

ServerLevel.finding: Adds/removes the coordinate in ForcedChunksSavedData.LongSet, marks saved data dirty, and updates chunk forced ticket. No 256-cardinality check.

method: Manual static review of official bytecode using Mojang mappings; deterministic geometry calculation recorded separately
scope_exclusions: No server launch or EULA acceptance
No JVM memory or achieved-tick-rate measurement
No live client rendering or lamp-update observation
No claim that this cache fixture is the complete computer
